A block marker on a continuation line of a link label is escaped

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<a href=\"https://example.com\">Alpha<br>-<br>Beta</a>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
